static_traits.name: Wang Wei
static_traits.family_status: Has two sisters,Mother is a dentist
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues;has one close friend but not yet shared feelings of inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;not yet received counseling or psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Expression is clear, can describe emotions and experiences concretely; feels tense at the moment; cooperativeness is relatively good; tends to focus on negative evidence; at the moment negative automatic thoughts are experienced as 'absolutely true'.

basic_info.main_problem: After Making a mistake at work (like burning a loaf of bread), often feeling like a 'useless Baker', fearing others' judgment and doubting one's abilities, leading to impaired confidence and work motivation, and affecting sleep and appetite.
basic_info.core_demands: Because these feelings of inadequacy are affecting my Work performance and overall well-being, I have decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Since starting a baking career, the client experiences intense Self-denial every time a mistake is made, forming a long-standing pattern of 'making a mistake = failure/incompetence'; these feelings of inadequacy have persisted since the start of the career, occurring several times a week at Work, with markedly increased stress when mistakes happen, fearing others' judgment and doubting one's abilities as a Baker; although trying to improve skills and pay more attention to details, the negative thinking persists, gradually affecting Work confidence and motivation, Interpersonal relationships (Tense relationships with colleagues), and daily life (Sleep disturbance and Decreased appetite).

special_situations.event: Burned a loaf of bread at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, it means I am incompetent, a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing harder on details, trying to improve skills to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: After making a mistake, interacts with colleagues or customers, worrying they see one's mistake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others see my mistakes, they will conclude I am not suited for this job
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Alienated from colleagues; reduces communication to lower chances of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all judging me/looking down on me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback does not count; only zero mistakes mean I am capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays or ignores positive feedback, continuously focuses attention on negatives and mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These praises do not show that I am not a failure

special_situations.event: After work, repeatedly replays mistakes from work, affecting sleep and appetite
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must constantly remind myself of mistakes, otherwise worse consequences will happen
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I relax, things will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable professional, and to be understood and accepted at work
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged as incompetent, being negated or humiliated
defense_goal: Preventing mistakes through Self-monitoring and self-criticism, avoiding external negation
Maintaining a certain distance in colleague relationships to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: Failure/incompetent person (negating the whole self once a mistake is made)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing how others view their work performance, or when the topic of others' evaluations is touched upon in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe others (including colleagues and customers) will judge one negatively, seeing them as bearing critical gazes (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing others' negative views, using an affirmative tone to assert 'they will think I am incompetent', sounding tense; downplaying or ignoring positive evidence raised by the counselor.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling or discussing a mistake at work (such as burning the bread)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing self and performance as 'all bad', finding it hard to acknowledge coexisting strengths and positive feedback (transference: understanding self/others in a Splitting manner)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolute language (like 'always''completely'), negating the middle ground and positive evidence; tone low, fixated on the failure narrative.

manifestations: Evaluating self as 'useless Baker''failure', equating one mistake with one's overall worth
Positive feedback (customer praise) is hard to maintain; subjective experience is covered by negative details
outcomes: Impaired self-esteem and Low sense of self-worth
Decreased work motivation and Interpersonal tension

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treating 'cannot make mistakes/zero errors' as the absolute standard for one's standing
Equating one mistake with 'not suited for this Work'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-doubt, highly tense at Work
Experiencing negative automatic thoughts in the present as 'completely true', finding it hard to accept other perspectives

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Has close friends but not yet talked about feelings of inadequacy, avoiding directly seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: When Making a mistake at work, the client usually falls into intense Self-denial and Anxiety, with Tense relationships with colleagues, and carries the negative experience back into life (affecting sleep and appetite).
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the moment of receiving a customer's praise for the pastries, the client experienced positive feedback and felt 'not bad', briefly refraining from equating one mistake with total negation.
exception_events.reason: Different support/situation: positive feedback from customers provided evidence contradicting the 'failure' belief; being seen and affirmed for concrete achievements improved the momentary experience of self-worth.

positive_force: Occasionally praised by customers; there is real evidence contrary to the negative belief
Willing to try recording positive feedback; good cooperation
Has one close friend as a potential support resource
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies toward catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking
Over-focusing on negative details, negating positive feedback
Tense relationships with colleagues, leading to reduced Social support and reality-correcting information
Sleep and appetite affected, further weakening emotion and cognition regulation abilities

target_behavior.behavior: After making mistakes at Work, developing intense Self-denial and Anxiety (with rumination, tension), and Avoiding communication with colleagues
antecedent: Making mistakes in baking work (such as burning the bread)
After an error occurs, I need to interact with colleagues or customers, worrying about being seen and evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: Formed the core belief of 'making mistakes = failure/incompetence', with high sensitivity to others' evaluations and catastrophic anticipation (believing one mistake will be completely negated).
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome things (negative evaluation/shame), gaining short-term psychological safety and a sense of control through Self-monitoring and avoidance.
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance and Decreased motivation;Tense relationships with colleagues;Sleep and appetite affected;persistent Self-worth damaged.
